entities.summary: Stephen Joseph Perry SJ FRS was an English Jesuit and astronomer, who was in charge of Stonyhurst observatory. He also made long voyages as a participant in scientific expeditions, particularly in studies of solar eclipses, terrestrial magnetism and meteorology.
